source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Insert RAID adapter and power on.
2. Boot into BIOS and check  HDD/ SSD in RAID adapter information correctly.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Can enter into BIOS without any problems.
2. The controller info displays correctly.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Truncated storcli show all and lsblk output.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; read-only inventory is useful but cannot perform adapter insertion or prove BIOS entry/display, and truncated generic output may omit required identity.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds adapter/slot compatibility, physical operator, BIOS evidence, controller-matched read-only tool and no-array-mutation boundary.

original_test_intent: Verify that the approved RAID adapter and attached HDD/SSD topology are installed correctly, BIOS is accessible and displays the expected controller and drive information, with OS/controller inventory as supporting evidence.
original_method: A qualified operator installs the exact adapter in a safe power state, powers on, enters BIOS and records controller/drive fields; the agent then collects complete read-only controller, physical/virtual-drive, OS and BMC evidence for the same identities.
manual_activity: Physical adapter installation and human BIOS navigation/visual verification are core acceptance actions. The agent may collect controller CLI evidence but cannot claim either manual action, so MANUAL ONLY applies.
required_inputs: Adapter part/serial/firmware, compatible PCIe slot and board revision
Attached drive serials, ports/enclosure slots and expected topology
BIOS version/menu path and expected controller/drive fields
Qualified operator, powered-safe/ESD procedure and KVM
Approved storcli/perccli/ssacli version and exact read-only inventory syntax
safety_requirements: Do not insert/remove the adapter energized unless vendor procedure explicitly permits it; apply ESD and slot/power compatibility controls.
Keep all controller commands read-only; never create, initialize, import, clear or rebuild arrays.
Do not assume controller index 0 or infer BIOS success from CLI visibility.
Stop on wrong adapter/topology, connector resistance, power fault, unexpected array state or boot issue; preserve evidence.
agent_execution_scope: Validate hardware/topology/BIOS/CLI evidence matrix before operator work.
After stable installation and BIOS evidence, capture complete controller/drive/virtual-disk/OS/BMC inventory without truncation.
Reconcile identities and report Tool Result without claiming BIOS/physical work or verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve and physically install the adapter/topology.
Enter BIOS and visually attest every required controller/drive field.
Resolve mismatches and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Read-only but incomplete: `head -60` can omit fields, utility must match controller vendor, and CLI/lsblk cannot prove BIOS display.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain manual BIOS inspection and use a controller-matched full read-only inventory plus reviewed project script as supplemental evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Adapter insertion/power-on, BIOS HDD/SSD information check, script and 5/5-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: MANUAL BIOS CHECK WITH COMPLETE READ-ONLY INVENTORY
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use an adapter-slot-drive manifest, timestamped KVM screenshots and full controller/physical/virtual-drive output correlated to OS and BMC identities.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, adapter firmware/driver, CLI/script and drive firmware versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform RAID compatibility/BOM and BIOS/controller documentation plus referenced script.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds complete identity correlation without replacing physical/BIOS work.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Hardware topology and BIOS field expectations.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS/controller visibility does not prove BIOS rendering or physical installation quality.

project_override_considerations: Project-specific adapter/slot/topology and BIOS fields are readiness inputs. Evidence and claims must name the exact population.
expected_evidence: Operator-attributed BIOS entry and controller/drive screenshots
Full controller/physical/virtual-drive and OS mapping plus tool versions
BMC/SEL/host logs, identity reconciliation, Tool Result and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criteria consistently require BIOS detection/display after adapter installation.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Intent is clear; missing hardware/tool/fields are readiness, while physical/BIOS core is MANUAL ONLY.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains CLI support but rejects YES and truncated evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains safety/topology gates while applying MANUAL ONLY to physical and BIOS acceptance.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Requires complete controller output and exact cross-layer identity mapping.

review_improvement: Prevents Linux inventory from being misreported as BIOS validation and prohibits accidental RAID mutation.
independent_technical_reasoning: The accepted outcome includes physical installation and visible BIOS fields. These are human core actions/observations, so MANUAL ONLY is correct despite useful read-only automation.
no_automatic_retry: Do not reseat, reboot or query alternate controller indices automatically after mismatch. Preserve evidence and await owner direction.
